purpose: Supplement the unchanged full-character quality contract with reproducible local hand gates; never replace the whole-character, animation or delivery checks.
scale: Character1.74m; all local distances in metres. Glove fitted to the actual measured wrist and palm before comparison.

poses.open: Identity FK matrices, neutral palm and digits, no hand-specific shape hiding
poses.small-curl: .30rad proximal curl; per-bone front.cross(direction) axis with negative angle verified by actual vertex displacement
poses.single-grip: hip=.89; right grip=(-.08,-.29,1.12), left=(.08,-.29,1.12); sword axis=(0,-.1,.995); initial curl=.85. Authoring corrections must be logged and all poses replayed without changing the fixture.

local_views.lighting: Same r006 frozen Eevee studio; no VFX
local_views.camera_target: Evaluated wrist-to-hand-bone point at60percent, same geometric rule for all candidates
local_views.additional_views: Unoccluded gray glove and wireframe views of palm root, finger webs, wrist inner cuff; diagnostic only, not replacements for textured assembled views. Use camera matching the anatomical surface if original world camera misses it and label this as an added diagnostic view.

required: four identifiable finger branches plus opposable thumb
joint loops and smooth root transitions
no poles or fan patch in thumb flexion zone
anatomy_topology.boundary_policy: No unplanned nonmanifold edges. A documented cuff opening is permitted; an opening is not automatically a broken mesh. No generic center-fan capping to claim closure.

rig.allowed_digit_influences: Hand plus own finger/own thumb bones; smooth adjacent-joint blending. No sibling-digit weights.
required_checks: joint centers within actual glove volume
open/small-curl/grip without flattening, spikes or folded palm-root flaps
rig.stretch_ratios: Record edge compression/stretch and worst locations as diagnostics; numerical improvement cannot replace visible shape acceptance.

surface_contact.mask: Freeze finger1..4 and thumb palmar pad masks in rest mesh before any grip search, using named anatomy and palmar-side normals; archive actual vertex/face IDs for each changed topology. Do not select nearest vertices after posing.
surface_contact.target: Actual complete sword triangles; handle surface mask axial range(-.112,.085)m relative to actual sword root, as in baseline; assert handle mask nonempty and audit orientation.
surface_contact.inside_method: Two odd/even rays against actual welded closed sword; verify closedness first. Disagreement, unknown or nonclosed solid invalidates inside evidence.
surface_contact.sampling: All glove vertices plus face centers and edge midpoints, including palm/root, not just the contact pads
surface_contact.triangle_intersection: Check actual evaluated glove triangles against handle/guard triangles for transverse crossings, retain locations and numerical tolerance; sample-only zero penetration never constitutes collision PASS.
surface_contact.visual_required: Finger pads wrap the handle and thumb opposes them in palm/side/back views; no finger-to-finger fusion or weapon cutting through hand.

required: hand and rigid bracer remain independent
cuff clears wrist through all tested poses
no exposed wrist seam or torso/armor clipping
brown leather style consistent with original reference
new UV islands packed deliberately, no cross-island interpolation
source textures/materials archived; rebake only after functional prototype passes
fitting_materials.preserve: All protected core geometry/UVs and raw equipment sources; dependent simplification saved as a new derived version and compared at the same five full-character views.

budget.strategy: Measure generated glove first. Keep needed finger-loop density; if source exceeds available budget, document small rigid shoulder/bracer simplification and validate silhouette, materials and all poses. Do not lower the60k whole-character limit.

search_protocol.events: Every candidate and every baseline/final readback gets its own event kind, timestamp, parameters, contact/deformation result and subject SHA or in-memory candidate fingerprint; no counter-only gap.
search_protocol.stop: No repeat on the same known failure after two attempts without new evidence/method. API pending/unknown stops new submissions. A failed local gate is saved and counts in the phase revision budget.

acceptance: All local gates and actual visual review must pass before extending the hand to the other side and the full stress poses. All full r006 quality dimensions,300frames/60fps, independent VFX, fresh GLB animation roundtrip and package checks remain required for delivery.
